AbbVie successfully diversified post-Humira with Rinvoq/Skyrizi. Pfizer pursuing GLP-1/obesity market aggressively (Metsera acquisition, 10 Phase 3 trials by end 2026). AbbVie, Lilly, Pfizer, Merck, and J&J all competing in IBD combination therapy — a $20B market with pivotal trial data expected. J&J raised 2026 outlook while peers face headwinds.
